title: Kissed Polish Pork Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish featuring tender pork and a kiss of garlic.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced sausage to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cubed potatoes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked pork, sausage, and skillet seasoning to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer the mixture for 10-15 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
